messages:
olivia: deploybot failed to promote canary, marking manual-hold. anyone seeing why?

deploy-bot: Promotion failed at step=promote-canary, reason=artifact-pruner-concurrency. error=412 Conflict. shard-prune-lock held by job=pruner-7f8b.
```
Error: failed to move artifact: prune lock conflict
  at /srv/pruner/main.go:421
  code=412; shard=us-west-2-a/17
```

ci-bot: FYI postsubmit windows show 3 failing integration runs in the last 12h for release/2026-03. Flake pattern: tests/integration/user-session-namespace::TestNamespaceCleanup intermittent. Link: https://ci.internal/builds/3457/logs

mike: hmm looks like prune raced with publish. Could be pruner TTL too aggressive after the mirroring tweak last week.

raj: two things: 1) if we pin to last-good digest we can promote now 2) if the integ test is the problematic commit we might want a rollback or revert. change window is 19:00 PT — we could delay final cut until then.

emma: i ran the failing test locally against image digest sha256:abc1234 and saw it fail once in ~10 runs. looks flaky, not a compile/build issue.

sophia: +1 to pin. rolling back a migration won't be trivial (depends on migration 20260312-add-session-index). we should avoid revert unless we confirm.

olivia: option vote: pin -> manual promote -> follow-up pruner tuning and postmortem. who can run manual promote and update release notes? :eyes:

jules: I can do manual promote and create the release notes entry. steps I plan: 1) pin image in deploy config to sha256:abc1234 2) run deploy promote --manual --canary 3) sanity smoke 4) update release notes with explanation and link to follow-up issue.

mike: steps look good. add a line in notes about the pruner race and that we held change window for safe rollback plan.

olivia: thanks. jules pls coordinate with infra to unblock pruner lock before promote. infra: @raj can you nudge the pruner owner?

raj: pinging infra pager and pruner oncall. looks like pruner job got rescheduled and is holding the shard for ~7m. will ask them to cancel and backfill.

deploy-bot: note: automatic retry attempted 2x and paused. promote command below (dry-run shown):
```
# dry-run promote
deployctl promote --cluster=prod-us-west --repo=release/2026-03 --image=sha256:abc1234 --canary --dry-run
```

jules: ran manual promote now after infra cleared the prune lock. smoke passes (auth + basic read path). updating release notes and tagging release with pinned digest. will open follow-up issue for pruner TTL and pruning coordination.

deploy-bot: manual promote complete. canary promoted to 2 replicas in prod-us-west.

olivia: great — leaving change-window delayed to 19:00 PT as a precaution. jules pls add rollback instructions to the notes (how to revert to previous image digest). :thumbsup:

jules: added notes + rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/api api=registry.internal/release:sha256:def5678 --namespace=prod
```

olivia: thanks team. i'll schedule the change-window update and mark this thread as follow-up for postmortem on pruner concurrency.
